title: Stash Tag Curator v3 rules taxonomy
description: Validates the v3 rules structure consumed by curator/rules.py (T8). Structural invariants live here; semantic invariants (cross-bucket partial-overlap ranges, canonical-tag reference integrity, normalization collisions, min<=max per bucket) are enforced by the Python runtime validator T8 — pure JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot compare sibling values. See .sisyphus/plans/stash-tag-curator.md T3 and planning-handoff.md L750-789, L793.

version.description: Rules schema version. v3 is the migrated taxonomy (D13).

prefixes.description: Exactly the 12 axis keys (5 computed + 7 rule-mapped), each mapping to its tag-name prefix string. Mirrors config_loader.EXPECTED_PREFIX_KEYS.

canonical_tags.description: Axis name -> array of canonical tag names. Keys MUST be one of the 12 axis names (any subset may appear; computed axes are typically present as empty arrays since their tags are derived at runtime). Every non-empty canonical name must carry an axis prefix.

mappings.description: Normalized source key (strip().lower().rstrip(',')) -> mapping rule. map and ignore are mutually exclusive by construction: 'map'/'detail' REQUIRE outputs, 'ignore' FORBIDS outputs. 'defer' (Issue 10) carries pending-review entries and leaves outputs optional.

disposition.description: map=emit outputs; detail=emit outputs as detail tags; ignore=drop silently (no outputs allowed); defer=pending human review (outputs optional).

outputs.description: Destination tag(s). Required for map/detail; forbidden for ignore; optional for defer. A single source key MAY map to many outputs (one-to-many).

notes.description: Audit rationale (migrated from v2 comments, collision reviews, flagged mis-mappings).

provider.description: Provider(s) this mapping is scoped to (e.g. stashdb, tpdb). Omit for all-provider applicability.

allOf.comment: map -> outputs REQUIRED (rejects map without outputs)
ignore -> outputs FORBIDDEN (map/ignore mutual exclusivity, D-impl / handoff L793)

bucket.description: A single numeric bucket for age/height/weight. min/max are inclusive integer bounds; T2 represents open-ended terminals with a sentinel upper bound (e.g. age 60+ -> max 200), so both are integers. NOTE: pure JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot compare siblings, so min<=max per bucket and cross-bucket range partial-overlap are enforced by T8; this schema rejects duplicate bucket definitions via uniqueItems on the enclosing array.

bucketArray.description: Ordered list of numeric buckets. uniqueItems rejects fully-overlapping (duplicate) bucket definitions; deep partial-overlap detection (e.g. [18-30] vs [23-29]) is the Python runtime validator T8's responsibility per the inherited notepad wisdom.

eraBucket.description: A single era bucket. Either bound may be omitted to denote an open-ended terminal (e.g. Pre-2000 omits min_year; 2020s omits max_year).

height_buckets.description: Performer height buckets in configured height_unit, default cm (D9/Issue 4).

weight_buckets.description: Performer weight buckets in configured weight_unit, default kg (D9/Issue 4).

era_buckets.description: Release-era buckets. (D6 removed automatic ERA: emission; the bucket catalog is retained for config completeness.)

age_min_valid.description: Sanity floor for computed age; below -> data-quality failure.

studio_passthrough.description: Pass studio name through as a STUDIO: tag.

additionalProperties.description: Variant spellings that canonicalize to the key.

ethnicity_aliases.description: Canonical ethnicity -> array of variant spellings (Caucasian==White, African American==Black, ...).

items.description: Exact tag name or prefix owned by the ethnicity subsystem.

ethnicity_owned_prefixes.description: Explicit set of tag-name patterns the ethnicity subsystem owns and may override on enrichment (Issue 11 / D9 narrow override).

country_aliases.description: ISO code / variant -> country name (emitted as 'DEMO: Country - <Name>'). May be empty when no aliases are configured.

cast_taxonomy.description: Cast-composition derivation config (D9/Issue 12). Counts by gender bucket in fixed order; ceiling >=4 total OR >=3 any -> group_label.

gender_order.description: Fixed emission order of gender codes, e.g. [M, F, TM, TF, NB, I, U].

additionalProperties.description: Stash gender enum(s) that roll up into this code.

gender_map.description: Code -> list of Stash gender enums (U -> [] for unknown).

group_total_ceiling.description: Total-count threshold at/above which the group label is emitted.

group_per_gender_cap.description: Per-gender count threshold at/above which the group label is emitted.

group_label.description: Tag emitted when a ceiling is met, e.g. 'CAST: Group'.

unknown_label.description: Tag emitted for an unknown/empty cast, e.g. 'CAST: Unknown'.

emit_order_strict.description: Emit zero-counts in fixed order when true.

married_irl_tag.description: Tag emitted when any performer carries the Married-IRL tag-id. Default 'THEME: Married IRL'.

jav_detection.description: JAV identification subsystem (scene-level signals). Emits tag_name when any signal fires: studio name in studio_names, a URL containing a url_substrings entry, scene.code matching code_pattern, or (when the code is absent/non-matching) the file basename starting with path_code_pattern. The two code-shaped signals are suppressed for studios in code_exempt_studios (western studios whose catalog codes share the JAV notation). Optional: an active rules file without this block simply leaves the subsystem disabled.

tag_name.description: Tag emitted for identified scenes. May be bare (no axis prefix), e.g. 'JAV'.

studio_names.description: Curated JAV studio/label names (matched case-insensitively after strip).

url_substrings.description: Case-insensitive URL substrings identifying JAV databases/aggregators (e.g. r18.dev, javdatabase).

code_pattern.description: Regex matched against scene.code (fullmatch semantics via anchors). Must compile; checked semantically at load time.

path_code_pattern.description: Regex matched against the start of the first file's basename when scene.code is absent or non-matching. Must compile.

code_exempt_studios.description: Studios whose letter-dash-digit catalog codes collide with the JAV notation (e.g. Evil Angel); suppresses only the code-shaped signals.

protected.description: D18 protected-tag preservation policy. Tags/prefixes listed here are never mutated by cleanup or enrichment override.

legacy.description: v2 backward-compat artifacts carried forward for audit (config_loader.LEGACY_LIST_KEYS). Not consumed by the v3 engine except for migration provenance.
